第19章 我最讨厌事后道歉（求追读）-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

媒介的形式不断变化，但形式都是在为解决同一个核心问题而服务，那就是更广泛的用户触及和更精确的信息传递。当然，还包括情绪传递。
谁能更好地实现这些功能，谁就能成为主流。
在报纸和杂志作为重要信息传递媒介的时代，他们的权威性不言而喻。部队内部都有规定，在省级报刊上发表文章，可以直接立三等功。如果能在《解放军报》和《解放军文艺》上发表文章，提干可以说是畅通无阻。
此时，鲁省某通讯团战士管谟叶刚训练完回到营房，顾不上喝水，迅速拿起桌子上的《解放军文艺》翻看，望着“刘济民”三个字，管谟叶心里嫉妒得发狂。
看到“刘济民”的简介，管莫叶忍不住叹了口气，这种好事怎么没轮到自己头上。二等功加上一篇在《解放军文艺》刊发的小说，提干已经是板上钉钉了。
“老管，你在看什么？”其他的战士望着脸色复杂的管莫叶，忍不住问道。
“没事，昨天给你们念的小说没看完，我再看会儿。”
“看杂志就看杂志，你脸怎么都快扭成一团了？”
“感慨一下，你说这人是多厉害，写这么好的小说，还立了二等功，上了大学，这前途亮的他还能睡着吗？”
“咦！我说你咋回事儿，是羡慕了啊！唉！提干都是小事，咱们宣传股的张股长，最多也就在军区的报纸上发过文章。”
管莫叶听完，心里更烦闷了，更是暗自下定决心，一定要通过写作提干。想要靠其他途径更上一层楼，他自觉轮不到自己。
此时，绿皮火车上，一个身穿绿军装、身材魁梧的军人放下手中的杂志，脸上带着无限感慨。他觉得自己很像《童年的朋友》里的孤儿侯志，两人有着相同的经历。父亲都是在战场上牺牲，从小跟孤儿院的朋友们相依为命。
不过有区别的是，自己在抗日战争时年纪尚小，没能为抗日战争出力。1949年，他12岁，他在孤儿院见到了南下解放桂林的解放军，软磨硬泡加入了文工团，从此部队就成了他的家。
“我要是早生几年，说不定我也是战功赫赫的侯志！”胡诗学笑着跟旁边的战友说道，“不过我也满足喽，要是当年文工团团长没有心软收下我，我现在还不知道在哪里讨饭。”
旁边的战友拿过桌子上的杂志，笑着问道：“老胡，你的笔上功夫也不错，什么时候能看到你的小说？”
“我？程咬金还有三板斧，我连三板斧都没有！”胡诗学起身准备去隔壁的车厢接水。
回来后，他纳闷地告诉同行的战友，有个老头一直在盯着他看。

Chapter 19 I hate apologizing afterwards the most (seeking further reading) - "Literary Man 1978: Beginning as a Military Writer"

The forms of media are constantly changing, but they all serve to solve the same core problem, which is wider user reach and more precise information delivery. Of course, it also includes emotional transmission.
Whoever can implement these functions better will become mainstream.
In an era when newspapers and magazines are important media for transmitting information, their authority is self-evident. There are regulations within the army that publishing an article in a provincial newspaper can directly earn third-class merit. If you can publish articles in the People's Liberation Army Daily and the People's Liberation Army Literature and Art, it can be said that there is no obstacle to promotion.
At this time, Guan Moye, a soldier from a communication regiment in Shandong Province, had just returned to the barracks after training. He didn't bother to drink water. He quickly picked up the "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" on the table and looked through it. Looking at the three words "Liu Jimin", Guan Moye felt crazy with jealousy.
Seeing the profile of "Liu Jimin", Guan Moye couldn't help but sigh, why didn't such a good thing happen to him? With second-class merit and a novel published in "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art", Tigan is already a sure thing.
"Old Guan, what are you looking at?" The other soldiers looked at Guan Moye with a complicated expression and couldn't help but ask.
"It's okay. I haven't finished the novel I read to you yesterday. I'll read it for a while."
"Just reading a magazine, why is your face almost twisted into a ball?"
"Excuse me, tell me how great this person is. He wrote such a good novel, got second-class merit, and went to university. Can he still sleep with such a bright future?"
"Eh! What's going on with you? I'm just jealous! Alas! It's all a trivial matter to get promoted. Chief Zhang of our publicity department has only published articles in newspapers in the military region at most."
After listening to this, Guan Moye felt even more depressed, and secretly made up his mind to improve himself through writing. If he wanted to reach a higher level through other means, he felt that it was not his turn.
At this time, on the green train, a burly soldier wearing a green military uniform put down the magazine in his hand, with infinite emotion on his face. He feels that he is very similar to the orphan Hou Zhi in "Childhood Friends", and the two have the same experience. His father died on the battlefield, and he lived with his friends in the orphanage since childhood.
However, the difference is that he was still young during the Anti-Japanese War and was unable to contribute to the Anti-Japanese War. In 1949, when he was 12 years old, he met the People's Liberation Army who went south to liberate Guilin in an orphanage, and he joined the art troupe through hard work. From then on, the army became his home.
"If I had been born a few years earlier, maybe I would have been Hou Zhi with great military exploits!" Hu Shixue smiled and said to his comrades next to him, "But I am satisfied. If the head of the art troupe had not been soft-hearted and accepted me, I don't know where I would beg for food now."
The comrade next to him took the magazine on the table and asked with a smile: "Lao Hu, your writing skills are also good. When can I see your novel?"
"Me? Cheng Yaojin still has three axes, I don't even have three axes!" Hu Shixue stood up and prepared to go to the next car to collect water.
After returning, he told his comrades in confusion that an old man had been staring at him.
